name: man
purpose: Manual — display the built-in reference manual page for a terminal command.
explanation: Opens scrollable documentation detailing a command's syntax, flags, and exit codes. Press `q` to quit.
expectedOutput: (Opens interactive manual page for ls; press q to exit)
whenToUse: When you need to verify exact flags for a command offline.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to press `q` to exit the pager.
